digest.component_or_area: LLM provider integration / Pydantic AI OpenAI compatibility
propositions: Pydantic AI 1.107+ emits PydanticAIDeprecationWarning when rebar constructs model targets using the legacy openai: prefix, which will change meaning from Chat Completions to Responses in v2.
Rebar's anthropic_model._pai_model and model_classes._resolve_target independently compose or return the ambiguous openai: qualifier for inferred and explicitly configured OpenAI provider targets.

ProviderSession registers custom base_url builder and per-candidate endpoint overrides keyed only on bare openai provider name, so explicit openai-chat: targets would bypass endpoint injection without additional gates.

All live OpenAI model construction paths (primary inference, explicit legacy targets, model-class primaries, fallback resolution) must normalize to openai-chat: to preserve Chat Completions wire protocol and emit no v2 deprecation warning.
Custom-endpoint routing and profile overrides must recognize both legacy openai and explicit openai-chat: qualifiers to maintain compatibility during the normalization.
